sentences.en: Supply of oil from the Middle East may be disturbed.
sentences.zh: 中东的石油供应可能会被打乱。

sentences.en: He keeps quiet so that he won't disturb his father.
sentences.zh: 他保持安静以免打扰父亲。

sentences.en: I didn't call on you for fear of disturbing you.
sentences.zh: 我本来不想打电话打扰你。

senses.zh: 打扰；妨碍；弄乱；使不安；使恼怒 -
